\"DPP: Only taker\");\n        require(_noStake != isNoStakeByIntentHash[_intentHash], \"DPP: Mode unchanged\");\n\n        if (_noStake) {\n            intent.stakeOwner = address(0);\n            isNoStakeByIntentHash[_intentHash] = _noStake;\n            stakeVault.unlockStake(_intentHash);\n        } else {\n            IntentLifecycleHookV1 hook = IntentLifecycleHookV1(address(_orchestrator.getIntentLifecycleHook(_intentHash)));\n            if (!isLifecycleHookAuthorizedByHook[address(hook)]) revert UnauthorizedLifecycleHook(address(hook));\n            require(hook.orchestratorRegistry().isOrchestrator(address(_orchestrator)), \"DPP: Unregistered orchestrator\");\n            IOrchestratorV3.Intent memory paymentIntent = _orchestrator.getIntent(_intentHash);\n            intent.stakeOwner = stakeVault.stakeOwnerOf(intent.taker);\n            isNoStakeByIntentHash[_intentHash] = _noStake;\n            stakeVault.lockStake(intent.stakeOwner, _intentHash, paymentIntent.amount, PENDING_COVERAGE_MATURITY);\n        }\n        emit DisputeProtectionIntentStakeModeChanged(_intentHash, intent.stakeOwner, _noStake);\n    }\n\n    /* ============ Permissionless Functions ============ */\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Releases collateral for one settled intent once its minimum risk window has elapsed.\n     * @dev Disputes remain valid after `releaseEligibleAt` until this release transaction executes.\n     * @param _intentHash Settled dispute protection intent whose collateral should be unlocked.\n     */\n    function releaseMaturedDisputeProtectionIntent(bytes32 _intentHash) external nonReentrant {\n        _releaseMaturedDisputeProtectionIntent(_intentHash);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Releases collateral for a batch of settled intents whose minimum risk windows have elapsed.\n     * @dev The batch is atomic: one invalid or ineligible intent reverts every release in the call.\n     * @param _intentHashes Settled dispute protection intents whose collateral should be unlocked.\n     */\n    function releaseMaturedDisputeProtectionIntents(bytes32[] calldata _intentHashes) external nonReentrant {\n        for (uint256 intentIndex = 0; intentIndex < _intentHashes.length; intentIndex++) {\n            _releaseMaturedDisputeProtectionIntent(_intentHashes[intentIndex]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Resolves valid dispute evidence into an immediately claimable depositor award.\n     * @dev A settled intent remains disputable until its collateral release executes, even after\n     * `releaseEligibleAt`. The dedicated dispute nullifier registry atomically rejects replayed disputes.\n     * @param _attestation Signed dispute evidence for a settled intent.\n     */\n    function submitDispute(IDisputeVerifier.DisputeAttestation calldata _attestation) external nonReentrant {\n        DisputeProtectionIntent storage disputeProtectionIntent =\n            disputeProtectionIntentByIntentHash[_attestation.intentHash];\n        if (disputeProtectionIntent.status != DisputeProtectionIntentStatus.SETTLED) {\n            revert DisputeProtectionIntentNotSettled(_attestation.intentHash, disputeProtectionIntent.status);\n        }\n\n        (bytes32 disputeId, bytes32 disputeNullifier) =\n            disputeVerifier.verifyDispute(_attestation, disputeProtectionIntent.paymentMethod);\n        disputeNullifierRegistry.addNullifier(disputeNullifier);\n\n        uint256 compensatedAmount = disputeProtectionIntent.releaseAmount;\n        disputeProtectionIntent.status = DisputeProtectionIntentStatus.DISPUTED;\n\n        IStakeVault.Claim[] memory claims = new IStakeVault.Claim[](1);\n        claims[0] = IStakeVault.Claim({beneficiary: disputeProtectionIntent.depositor, amount: compensatedAmount});\n        stakeVault.resolveLock(_attestation.intentHash, claims);\n\n        emit DisputeResolved(\n            _attestation.intentHash,\n            disputeProtectionIntent.stakeOwner,\n            disputeProtectionIntent.depositor,\n            compensatedAmount,\n            disputeId\n        );\n    }\n\n    /* ============ Depositor Functions ============ */\n\n    /**\n     * @notice DEPOSITOR ONLY: Updates dispute protection for one deposit payment method.\n     * @dev Protection is enabled by default on every payment method with a nonzero risk window; passing false opts the\n     * tuple out and true undoes the opt-out. The requested value is emitted as-is; the effective state also depends on\n     * the payment method's current risk window. OrchestratorV3 validates Escrow registration before signaling an\n     * intent; this policy only verifies that the caller is the deposit's current depositor.\n     * @param _escrow Escrow containing the deposit.\n     * @param _depositId Deposit whose payment-method-specific configuration is updated.\n     * @param _paymentMethod Payment method whose dispute protection configuration is updated.\n     * @param _isEnabled Whether non-whitelisted takers may use stake-backed dispute protection on this payment method;\n     * false opts out.\n     */\n    function setDisputeProtectionEnabled(address _escrow, uint256 _depositId, bytes32 _paymentMethod, bool _isEnabled)\n        external\n        onlyDepositor(_escrow, _depositId)\n    {\n        isDisputeProtectionDisabledByPaymentMethod[_escrow][_depositId][_paymentMethod] = !_isEnabled;\n        emit DisputeProtectionEnabledUpdated(_escrow, _depositId, _paymentMethod, _isEnabled);\n    }\n\n    /* ============ Governance Functions ============ */\n\n    /**\n     * @notice GOVERNANCE ONLY: Sets the minimum collateral lock window for future intents of a payment method.\n     * @dev A zero window means the payment method is never routed through dispute protection: the lifecycle hook then\n     * applies the deposit's whitelist (rejecting non-members when it is enabled) or admits openly when it is disabled.\n     * Changing the window affects future admissions only; admitted intents keep their snapshotted window.\n     * @param _paymentMethod Payment method whose future risk window is updated.\n     * @param _riskWindow Minimum seconds collateral remains locked after settlement.\n     */\n    function setRiskWindow(bytes32 _paymentMethod, uint64 _riskWindow) external onlyOwner {\n        if (_riskWindow > MAX_RISK_WINDOW) revert InvalidRiskWindow(_riskWindow);\n        paymentMethodRiskWindow[_paymentMethod] = _riskWindow;\n        emit RiskWindowUpdated(_paymentMethod, _riskWindow);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice GOVERNANCE ONLY: Replaces the verifier used for future dispute submissions.\n     * @param _verifier New non-zero deployed dispute verifier.\n     */\n    function setDisputeVerifier(address _verifier) external onlyOwner {\n        _validateDependency(_verifier);\n        address previousVerifier = address(disputeVerifier);\n        disputeVerifier = IDisputeVerifier(_verifier);\n        emit DisputeVerifierUpdated(previousVerifier, _verifier);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice GOVERNANCE ONLY: Authorizes or revokes one lifecycle hook.\n     * @dev Authorize a hook before configuring it on an Orchestrator. Revoke a predecessor only after every intent\n     * snapshotted to it has been cancelled or settled.\n     * @param _hook Lifecycle hook whose callback authority is updated.\n     * @param _isAuthorized Whether the hook may mutate dispute protection intent state.\n     */\n    function setLifecycleHookAuthorization(address _hook, bool _isAuthorized) external onlyOwner {\n        if (_isAuthorized) _validateDependency(_hook);\n        isLifecycleHookAuthorizedByHook[_hook] = _isAuthorized;\n        emit LifecycleHookAuthorizationUpdated(_hook, _isAuthorized);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice GOVERNANCE ONLY: Pauses or resumes new dispute-protection admissions.\n     * @dev It rejects every non-whitelisted taker on every non-opted-out deposit payment method with a nonzero risk\n     * window. Whitelisted takers return from the lifecycle hook before this policy is reached, and payment methods with\n     * a zero risk window return before the pause check. Explicitly opted-out deposit payment methods and zero-window\n     * payment methods never reach this policy and stay gated by the whitelist or open. Cancellation, settlement,\n     * release, and dispute submission remain available while admissions are paused.\n     * @param _isPaused Whether new dispute protection admissions should revert.\n     */\n    function setAdmissionsPaused(bool _isPaused) external onlyOwner {\n        admissionsPaused = _isPaused;\n        emit AdmissionsPausedUpdated(_isPaused);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice GOVERNANCE ONLY: Accepts this policy as StakeVault's controller after its handover delay.\n     * @dev Before replacing another policy, governance must drain its active dispute protection intents or execute an\n     * explicit state-and-lock migration. Accepting controller authority alone cannot import the predecessor's intent\n     * state.\n     */\n    function acceptVaultController() external onlyOwner {\n        stakeVault.acceptController();\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice GOVERNANCE ONLY: Releases predecessor settlement locks early after controller handover.\n     * @dev Ends the remaining dispute coverage without moving tokens or importing predecessor policy records.\n     * Pending predecessor locks retain PENDING_COVERAGE_MATURITY and cannot be released here. Drain those intents\n     * before handover: their snapshotted hooks still call the predecessor, which loses vault authority.\n     * @param _intentHashes Predecessor settled intents whose collateral should become free stake.\n     */\n    function releasePredecessorLocks(bytes32[] calldata _intentHashes) external onlyOwner {\n        for (uint256 i; i < _intentHashes.length; i++) {\n            bytes32 intentHash = _intentHashes[i];\n            if (disputeProtectionIntentByIntentHash[intentHash].status != DisputeProtectionIntentStatus.NONE) {\n                revert DisputeProtectionIntentAlreadyExists(intentHash);\n            }\n            (,, uint64 maturesAt) = stakeVault.locks(intentHash);\n            require(maturesAt != PENDING_COVERAGE_MATURITY, \"DPP: Pending predecessor intent\");\n            stakeVault.unlockStake(intentHash);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Disables ownership renunciation so governed safety controls cannot become unreachable.\n     */\n    function renounceOwnership() public view override onlyOwner {\n        revert OwnershipRenunciationDisabled();\n    }\n\n    /* ============ View Functions ============ */\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Returns the authoritative stake mode for an intent.\n     * @param _intentHash Intent whose stake mode is queried.\n     * @return True for no-stake mode; false for staked or unknown intents.\n     */\n    function isIntentNoStake(bytes32 _intentHash) external view returns (bool) {\n        return isNoStakeByIntentHash[_intentHash];\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IPaymentValidationHook\n    function validatePayment(bytes32 _intentHash, bytes calldata _data, bytes calldata) external view override {\n        DisputeProtectionIntent storage intent = disputeProtectionIntentByIntentHash[_intentHash];\n        if (intent.status == DisputeProtectionIntentStatus.PENDING && isNoStakeByIntentHash[_intentHash]) {\n            (,, bool bypassState) = abi.decode(\n                _data, (UnifiedPaymentVerifierV4.PaymentDetails, UnifiedPaymentVerifierV4.IntentSnapshot, bool)\n            );\n            require(bypassState, \"DPP: Payment cannot bypass\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Returns the stored dispute protection state for an intent.\n     * @param _intentHash Intent whose dispute protection state is queried.\n     */\n    function getDisputeProtectionIntent(bytes32 _intentHash) external view returns (DisputeProtectionIntent memory) {\n        return disputeProtectionIntentByIntentHash[_intentHash];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Returns the effective stake-backed dispute protection state for a deposit payment method.\n     * @dev True when the depositor has not opted the tuple out and the payment method has a nonzero risk window.\n     * Performs no validation: any escrow, any deposit id (including nonexistent ones), and any payment method with a\n     * nonzero window read true.\n     * @param _escrow Escrow containing the deposit.\n     * @param _depositId Deposit whose payment-method-specific configuration is queried.\n     * @param _paymentMethod Payment method whose dispute protection configuration is queried.\n     */\n    function isDisputeProtectionEnabled(address _escrow, uint256 _depositId, bytes32 _paymentMethod)\n        external\n        view\n        override\n        returns (bool)\n    {\n        return !isDisputeProtectionDisabledByPaymentMethod[_escrow][_depositId][_paymentMethod]\n            && paymentMethodRiskWindow[_paymentMethod] != 0;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Returns whether a lifecycle hook may mutate dispute protection intent state.\n     * @param _hook Lifecycle hook whose callback authorization is queried.\n     */\n    function isLifecycleHookAuthorized(address _hook) external view returns (bool) {\n        return isLifecycleHookAuthorizedByHook[_hook];\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Returns the risk window applied to future intents for a payment method.\n     * @param _paymentMethod Payment method whose configured risk window is queried.\n     */\n    function getRiskWindow(bytes32 _paymentMethod) external view returns (uint64) {\n        return paymentMethodRiskWindow[_paymentMethod];\n    }\n\n    /* ============ Internal Functions ============ */\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Validates policy-owned admission requirements and returns the collateral owner and depositor to snapshot.\n     * StakeVault remains authoritative for collateral sufficiency and reverts from `lockStake` when free stake is\n     * insufficient.\n     */\n    function _validateIntentAdmission(\n        bytes32 _intentHash,\n        address _escrow,\n        uint256 _depositId,\n        bytes32 _paymentMethod,\n        address _taker\n    ) internal view returns (address stakeOwner, address depositor) {\n        if (admissionsPaused) revert AdmissionsPaused();\n        if (disputeProtectionIntentByIntentHash[_intentHash].status != DisputeProtectionIntentStatus.NONE) {\n            revert DisputeProtectionIntentAlreadyExists(_intentHash);\n        }\n        if (isDisputeProtectionDisabledByPaymentMethod[_escrow][_depositId][_paymentMethod]) {\n            revert DisputeProtectionNotEnabled(_escrow, _depositId, _paymentMethod);\n        }\n\n        IEscrowV2.Deposit memory deposit = IEscrowV2(_escrow).getDeposit(_depositId);\n        address expectedToken = address(stakeVault.stakeToken());\n        if (address(deposit.token) != expectedToken) {\n            revert IntentTokenMismatch(expectedToken, address(deposit.token));\n        }\n\n        stakeOwner = stakeVault.stakeOwnerOf(_taker);\n        depositor = deposit.depositor;\n    }\n\n    function _releaseMaturedDisputeProtectionIntent(bytes32 _intentHash) internal {\n        DisputeProtectionIntent storage disputeProtectionIntent = disputeProtectionIntentByIntentHash[_intentHash];\n        if (disputeProtectionIntent.status != DisputeProtectionIntentStatus.SETTLED) {\n            revert DisputeProtectionIntentNotSettled(_intentHash, disputeProtectionIntent.status);\n        }\n\n        uint64 currentTime = _currentTimestamp();\n        uint64 releaseEligibleAt = disputeProtectionIntent.releaseEligibleAt;\n        if (currentTime < releaseEligibleAt) {\n            revert DisputeProtectionIntentNotReleaseEligible(releaseEligibleAt, currentTime);\n        }\n\n        uint256 releasedAmount = disputeProtectionIntent.releaseAmount;\n        disputeProtectionIntent.status = DisputeProtectionIntentStatus.RELEASED;\n        stakeVault.unlockStake(_intentHash);\n        emit DisputeProtectionIntentReleased(_intentHash, disputeProtectionIntent.stakeOwner, releasedAmount);\n    }\n\n    function _calculateReleaseEligibleAt(uint64 _riskWindow) internal view returns (uint64) {\n        uint256 releaseEligibleAt = block.timestamp + _riskWindow;\n        if (releaseEligibleAt > type(uint64).max) revert TimestampOverflow(releaseEligibleAt);\n        return uint64(releaseEligibleAt);\n    }\n\n    function _currentTimestamp() internal view returns (uint64) {\n        if (block.timestamp > type(uint64).max) revert TimestampOverflow(block.timestamp);\n        return uint64(block.timestamp);\n    }\n\n    function _validateDependency(address _dependency) internal view {\n        if (_dependency == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        if (_dependency.code.length == 0) revert InvalidContract(_dependency);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x128c578655329e49f7ec35dce06b6a29bbc65040329c7e3c829d4f555dc9b762","license":"MIT"},"contracts/hooks/IntentLifecycleHookV1.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.18;\n\nimport {IIntentLifecycleHook} from \"../interfaces/IIntentLifecycleHook.sol\";\nimport {IDisputeProtectionPolicy} from \"../interfaces/IDisputeProtectionPolicy.sol\";\nimport {IOrchestratorRegistry} from \"../interfaces/IOrchestratorRegistry.sol\";\nimport {IOrchestratorV3} from \"../interfaces/IOrchestratorV3.sol\";\nimport {IWhitelistPolicy} from \"../interfaces/IWhitelistPolicy.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title IntentLifecycleHookV1\n * @notice Lifecycle hook combining tuple-scoped whitelist admission with default-on, opt-out stake-backed dispute\n * protection. Whitelisted takers bypass staking. Non-whitelisted takers use stake-backed admission on payment methods\n * with a nonzero risk window unless the depositor opted the deposit payment method out; otherwise an enabled whitelist\n * rejects them while a whitelist-disabled deposit stays open. A payment method with a zero risk window is never routed\n * through dispute protection, so its whitelist remains the only gate. Protected intents may request no-stake admission\n * under the same access rules as staked admission, then fulfill through O3 with signed bypass evidence or explicitly\n * switch to staked mode.\n * @dev Reads canonical intent data from the calling orchestrator and forwards cancellation and settlement accounting\n * to DisputeProtectionPolicy. All callbacks remain fail-closed. This hook serves every registered orchestrator and\n * forwards lifecycle callbacks without provenance checks; the trust argument lives in DisputeProtectionPolicy's header.\n * Deregistering an orchestrator with unresolved intents snapshotted to this hook permanently blocks their terminal\n * callbacks, so governance must drain its intents before removing it from OrchestratorRegistry.\n * Governance must route protected payment methods through UPV4 before enabling this hook.\n */\ncontract IntentLifecycleHookV1 is IIntentLifecycleHook {\n    /* ============ State Variables ============ */\n\n    IOrchestratorRegistry public immutable orchestratorRegistry;\n    IWhitelistPolicy public immutable whitelistPolicy;\n    IDisputeProtectionPolicy public immutable disputeProtectionPolicy;\n\n    /* ============ Errors ============ */\n\n    error ZeroAddress();\n    error InvalidDependency(address dependency);\n    error UnauthorizedOrchestrator(address caller);\n    error IntentNotFound(bytes32 intentHash);\n    error TakerNotWhitelisted(address escrow, uint256 depositId, bytes32 paymentMethod, address taker);\n\n    /* ============ Constructor ============ */\n\n    constructor(\n        IOrchestratorRegistry _orchestratorRegistry,\n        IWhitelistPolicy _whitelistPolicy,\n        IDisputeProtectionPolicy _disputeProtectionPolicy\n    ) {\n        _validateDependency(address(_orchestratorRegistry));\n        _validateDependency(address(_whitelistPolicy));\n        _validateDependency(address(_disputeProtectionPolicy));\n\n        orchestratorRegistry = _orchestratorRegistry;\n        whitelistPolicy = _whitelistPolicy;\n        disputeProtectionPolicy = _disputeProtectionPolicy;\n    }\n\n    /* ============ Lifecycle Callbacks ============ */\n\n    /**\n     * @inheritdoc IIntentLifecycleHook\n     */\n    function onIntentSignaled(bytes32 _intentHash) external override onlyOrchestrator {\n        IOrchestratorV3.Intent memory intent = IOrchestratorV3(msg.sender).getIntent(_intentHash);\n        if (intent.owner == address(0)) revert IntentNotFound(_intentHash);\n\n        bool isWhitelistEnabled = whitelistPolicy.enabled(intent.escrow, intent.depositId, intent.paymentMethod);\n        if (\n            isWhitelistEnabled\n                && whitelistPolicy.isTakerAllowed(intent.escrow, intent.depositId, intent.paymentMethod, intent.owner)\n        ) {\n            return;\n        }\n        // Dispute protection admission is stateful, so the configuration query only selects the route.\n        // onIntentSignaled remains authoritative for token compatibility, collateral, and pause checks.\n        if (disputeProtectionPolicy.isDisputeProtectionEnabled(intent.escrow, intent.depositId, intent.paymentMethod)) {\n            require(intent.data.length != 0, \"ILH: Missing payment validation hook\");\n            (address validationHook, bytes memory hookData) = abi.decode(intent.data, (address, bytes));\n            require(validationHook == address(disputeProtectionPolicy), \"ILH: Invalid payment validation hook\");\n            bool noStake = abi.decode(hookData, (bool));\n            disputeProtectionPolicy.onIntentSignaled(\n                _intentHash, intent.escrow, intent.depositId, intent.owner, intent.paymentMethod, intent.amount, noStake\n            );\n        } else if (isWhitelistEnabled) {\n            revert TakerNotWhitelisted(intent.escrow, intent.depositId, intent.paymentMethod, intent.owner);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @inheritdoc IIntentLifecycleHook\n     */\n    function onIntentCancelled(bytes32 _intentHash) external override onlyOrchestrator {\n        disputeProtectionPolicy.onIntentCancelled(_intentHash);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @inheritdoc IIntentLifecycleHook\n     */\n    function settleIntent(SettlementContext calldata _context) external override onlyOrchestrator {\n        disputeProtectionPolicy.onIntentSettled(_context.intentHash, _context.releaseAmount, _context.isManualRelease);\n    }\n\n    /* ============ Modifiers ============ */\n\n    modifier onlyOrchestrator() {\n        if (!orchestratorRegistry.isOrchestrator(msg.sender)) revert UnauthorizedOrchestrator(msg.sender);\n        _;\n    }\n\n    /* ============ Internal Functions ============ */\n\n    function _validateDependency(address _dependency) internal view {\n        if (_dependency == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        if (_dependency.code.length == 0) revert InvalidDependency(_dependency);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x25fabc98374f0a75b861b590f0e2b71d489400072526c6d19e5e532c19302899","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/IAddressGroupRegistry.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.18;\n\n/**\n * @title IDisputeProtectionPolicy\n * @notice Lifecycle-hook integration surface for stake-backed dispute coverage.\n * @dev The concrete policy exposes depositor, governance, dispute, and release functions directly.\n *      This interface contains the functions consumed by the lifecycle hook.\n */\ninterface IDisputeProtectionPolicy {\n    /**\n     * @notice Lifecycle state of a dispute-protected intent.\n     * @dev `NONE` is the required zero-value sentinel for an uninitialized mapping entry; it is not a live state.\n     *      `SETTLED` means the underlying intent completed and its collateral remains disputable.\n     *      `RELEASED` means the collateral was returned and the intent is no longer disputable.\n     */\n    enum DisputeProtectionIntentStatus {\n        NONE,\n        PENDING,\n        CANCELLED,\n        SETTLED,\n        RELEASED,\n        DISPUTED\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Dispute protection state retained after an intent is admitted by the lifecycle hook.\n     * @param taker Account that signaled the intent.\n     * @param stakeOwner Account whose StakeVault balance collateralizes the intent; zero in no-stake mode.\n     * @param depositor Escrow depositor compensated by a successful dispute.\n     * @param paymentMethod Payment method used to namespace risk configuration and dispute nullifiers.\n     * @param status Current dispute protection lifecycle state.\n     * @param riskWindow Default collateral window saved at intent admission, including when admitted without stake.\n     * @param releaseEligibleAt Earliest timestamp at which collateral may be released. Dispute evidence remains\n     * valid after this time until release actually executes.\n     * @param releaseAmount Amount released from Escrow before fees and therefore collateralized after settlement.\n     */\n    struct DisputeProtectionIntent {\n        address taker;\n        address stakeOwner;\n        address depositor;\n        bytes32 paymentMethod;\n        DisputeProtectionIntentStatus status;\n        uint64 riskWindow;\n        uint64 releaseEligibleAt;\n        uint256 releaseAmount;\n    }\n\n    event DisputeProtectionIntentOpened(\n        bytes32 indexed intentHash,\n        address indexed stakeOwner,\n        address indexed depositor,\n        address taker,\n        bytes32 paymentMethod,\n        uint256 amount,\n        uint64 riskWindow\n    );\n    event DisputeProtectionIntentCancelled(\n        bytes32 indexed intentHash, address indexed stakeOwner, uint256 releasedAmount\n    );\n    event DisputeProtectionIntentStakeModeChanged(bytes32 indexed intentHash, address indexed stakeOwner, bool noStake);\n    event DisputeProtectionIntentSettled(\n        bytes32 indexed intentHash,\n SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.18;\n\nimport { Ownable } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport { Bytes32ArrayUtils } from \"../external/Bytes32ArrayUtils.sol\";\nimport { IAttestationVerifier } from \"../interfaces/IAttestationVerifier.sol\";\nimport { INullifierRegistryV2 } from \"../interfaces/INullifierRegistryV2.sol\";\nimport { IOrchestratorRegistry } from \"../interfaces/IOrchestratorRegistry.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title BaseUnifiedPaymentVerifierV3\n * @notice Base contract for unified payment verification that manages configuration for multiple payment methods.\n *\n * This contract handles:\n * - Supported payment methods\n * - Attestation verification through pluggable attestation verifiers\n *\n * @dev This is an abstract contract that must be inherited by concrete implementations.\n *      It replaces the previous BaseReclaimVerifier with a more flexible architecture.\n */\nabstract contract BaseUnifiedPaymentVerifierV3 is Ownable {\n\n    using Bytes32ArrayUtils for bytes32[];\n\n    /* ============ Constants ============ */\n\n    uint256 internal constant PRECISE_UNIT = 1e18;\n\n    /* ============ Events ============ */\n\n    event PaymentMethodAdded(bytes32 indexed paymentMethod);\n    event PaymentMethodRemoved(bytes32 indexed paymentMethod);\n    event AttestationVerifierUpdated(address indexed oldVerifier, address indexed newVerifier);\n    /* ============ State Variables ============ */\n\n    IOrchestratorRegistry public immutable orchestratorRegistry;\n    INullifierRegistryV2 public immutable nullifierRegistry;\n    IAttestationVerifier public attestationVerifier;\n\n    bytes32[] public paymentMethods;\n    mapping(bytes32 => bool) public isPaymentMethod;\n\n    /* ============ Modifiers ============ */\n\n    /**\n     * Modifier to ensure only an authorized orchestrator can call.\n     */\n    modifier onlyOrchestrator() {\n        require(orchestratorRegistry.isOrchestrator(msg.sender), \"Only orchestrator can call\");\n        _;\n    }\n\n    /* ============ Constructor ============ */\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Initializes base payment verifier\n     * @param _orchestratorRegistry The orchestrator registry contract that authorizes orchestrators\n     * @param _nullifierRegistry The nullifier registry contract that will be used to prevent double-spends\n     * @param _attestationVerifier The attestation verifier contract that will be used to verify attestation by the\n     * offchain / ZK attestation service\n     */\n    constructor(\n        IOrchestratorRegistry _orchestratorRegistry,\n        INullifierRegistryV2 _nullifierRegistry,\n        IAttestationVerifier _attestationVerifier\n    ) Ownable() {\n        require(address(_orchestratorRegistry).code.length != 0, \"UPV: Invalid orchestrator registry\");\n        require(address(_nullifierRegistry).code.length != 0, \"UPV: Invalid nullifier registry\");\n        require(address(_attestationVerifier).code.length != 0, \"UPV: Invalid attestation verifier\");\n        orchestratorRegistry = _orchestratorRegistry;\n        nullifierRegistry = _nullifierRegistry;\n        attestationVerifier = _attestationVerifier;\n    }\n\n    /* ============ External Functions ============ */\n\n    /**\n     * ONLY OWNER: Adds a new payment method with timestamp buffer\n     * @param _paymentMethod The payment method hash; Hash the payment method name in lowercase\n     */\n    function addPaymentMethod(bytes32 _paymentMethod) external onlyOwner {\n        require(!isPaymentMethod[_paymentMethod], \"UPV: Payment method already exists\");\n\n        isPaymentMethod[_paymentMethod] = true;\n        paymentMethods.push(_paymentMethod);\n\n        emit PaymentMethodAdded(_paymentMethod);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * ONLY OWNER: Removes a payment method and associated configuration\n     * @param _paymentMethod The payment method to remove\n     */\n    function removePaymentMethod(bytes32 _paymentMethod) external onlyOwner {\n        require(isPaymentMethod[_paymentMethod], \"UPV: Payment method does not exist\");\n\n        delete isPaymentMethod[_paymentMethod];\n        paymentMethods.removeStorage(_paymentMethod);\n\n        emit PaymentMethodRemoved(_paymentMethod);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Updates the attestation verifier contract\n     * @param _newVerifier The new attestation verifier address\n     */\n    function setAttestationVerifier(address _newVerifier) external onlyOwner {\n        address oldVerifier = address(attestationVerifier);\n        require(_newVerifier.code.length != 0, \"UPV: Invalid attestation verifier\");\n        require(_newVerifier != oldVerifier, \"UPV: Same verifier\");\n\n        attestationVerifier = IAttestationVerifier(_newVerifier);\n        emit AttestationVerifierUpdated(oldVerifier, _newVerifier);\n    }\n\n    /* ============ View Functions ============ */\n\n    function getPaymentMethods() external view returns (bytes32[] memory) {\n        return paymentMethods;\n    }\n\n    /* ============ Internal Functions ============ */\n\n    /**\n     * Validates and adds a nullifier to prevent double-spending\n     * @param _nullifier The nullifier to add\n     */\n    function _validateAndAddNullifier(bytes32 _nullifier, bytes32 _intentHash) internal {\n        require(!nullifierRegistry.isNullified(_nullifier), \"Nullifier has already been used\");\n        nullifierRegistry.addNullifier(_nullifier, _intentHash);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x48f8e3075f0482bdd6ed37979c447d7ee004ace55ede349e23c7c23c4740bac6","license":"MIT"},"contracts/unifiedVerifier/UnifiedPaymentVerifierV4.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.18;\n\nimport { BaseUnifiedPaymentVerifierV3 } from \"./BaseUnifiedPaymentVerifierV3.sol\";\nimport { INullifierRegistryV2 } from \"../interfaces/INullifierRegistryV2.sol\";\nimport { IPaymentVerifier } from \"../interfaces/IPaymentVerifier.sol\";\nimport { IAttestationVerifier } from \"../interfaces/IAttestationVerifier.sol\";\nimport { IOrchestrator } from \"../interfaces/IOrchestrator.sol\";\nimport { IOrchestratorV2 } from \"../interfaces/IOrchestratorV2.sol\";\nimport { IOrchestratorRegistry } from \"../interfaces/IOrchestratorRegistry.sol\";\nimport { IPaymentValidationHook } from \"../interfaces/IPaymentValidationHook.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title UnifiedPaymentVerifierV4\n * @notice Preserves V3 payment verification and forwards authenticated payment data to an intent-selected hook.\n *\n * Key features:\n * - Supports multiple payment methods, each with custom configuration\n * - Uses AttestationVerifier to validate offchain payment attestations\n * - Ensures trust anchor integrity for off-chain verification processes\n * - Verifies standardized payment details against provided data\n * @dev Payment attestations use this deployment's EIP-712 domain. Governance must reuse the payment-nullifier\n * registry, route payment methods to this verifier, and retire V3's registry write permission during activation.\n * Nonempty intent.data must encode (IPaymentValidationHook, bytes hookData). Admission enforces any required hook.\n */\ncontract UnifiedPaymentVerifierV4 is IPaymentVerifier, BaseUnifiedPaymentVerifierV3 {\n\n    /* ============ Constants ============ */\n\n    // Max timestamp buffer\n    uint256 private constant MAX_TIMESTAMP_BUFFER = 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 48 hours\n\n    // EIP-712 Domain Separator\n    bytes32 private constant DOMAIN_TYPEHASH = keccak256(\n        \"EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)\"\n    );\n\n    // EIP-712 Type Hash for PaymentAttestation\n    bytes32 private constant PAYMENT_ATTESTATION_TYPEHASH = keccak256(\n        \"PaymentAttestation(bytes32 intentHash,uint256 releaseAmount,bytes32 dataHash)\"\n    );\n\n    // Used to detect V2 orchestrators that expose getDepositPreIntentHook(address,uint256).\n    bytes4 private constant GET_DEPOSIT_PRE_INTENT_HOOK_SELECTOR =\n        bytes4(keccak256(\"getDepositPreIntentHook(address,uint256)\"));\n\n    /* ============ State Variables ============ */\n\n    // EIP-712 Domain Separator (computed once at deployment)\n    bytes32 public immutable DOMAIN_SEPARATOR;\n\n    /* ============ Events ============ */\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Capture and emit payment details for offchain reconciliation\n     */\n    event PaymentVerified(\n        bytes32 indexed intentHash,\n        bytes32 indexed method,\n        bytes32 indexed currency,\n        uint256 amount,\n        uint256 timestamp,\n        bytes32 paymentId,\n        bytes32 payeeId\n    );\n\n    /* ============ Structs ============ */\n\n    struct PaymentDetails {\n        bytes32 method;           // Payment method hash (e.g., \"venmo\", \"paypal\", \"wise\")\n        bytes32 payeeId;          // Payment recipient ID (hashed payee details to preserve privacy)\n        uint256 amount;           // Payment amount in smallest currency unit (i.e. cents)\n        bytes32 currency;         // Payment currency hash (e.g., \"USD\", \"EUR\")\n        uint256 timestamp;        // Payment timestamp in UTC in milliseconds\n        bytes32 paymentId;        // Hashed payment identifier from the service (e.g. hashed venmo payment ID to preserve privacy)\n    }\n\n    struct IntentSnapshot {\n        bytes32 intentHash;\n        uint256 amount;\n        bytes32 paymentMethod;\n        bytes32 fiatCurrency;\n        bytes32 payeeDetails;\n        uint256 conversionRate;\n        uint256 signalTimestamp;\n        uint256 timestampBuffer;\n    }\n\n    struct PaymentAttestation {\n        bytes32 intentHash;       // Binds the payment to the intent on Orchestrator\n        uint256 releaseAmount;    // Final token amount to release on-chain after FX\n        bytes32 dataHash;         // Hash of the additional data to verify integrity\n        bytes[] signatures;       // Array of signatures from witnesses\n        bytes data;               // Data for verification\n        bytes metadata;           // Additional metadata; isn't signed by the witnesses\n    }\n\n    /* ============ Constructor ============ */\n\n    constructor(\n        IOrchestratorRegistry _orchestratorRegistry,\n        INullifierRegistryV2 _nullifierRegistry,\n        IAttestationVerifier _attestationVerifier\n    ) BaseUnifiedPaymentVerifierV3(\n        _orchestratorRegistry,\n        _nullifierRegistry,\n        _attestationVerifier\n    ) {\n        // Compute EIP-712 domain separator\n        DOMAIN_SEPARATOR = keccak256(\n            abi.encode(\n                DOMAIN_TYPEHASH,\n                keccak256(bytes(\"UnifiedPaymentVerifier\")), // name\n                keccak256(bytes(\"1\")),                      // version\n                block.chainid,                              // chainId\n                address(this)                               // verifyingContract\n            )\n        );\n    }\n\n    /* ============ External Functions ============ */\n\n    /**\n     * ONLY ORCHESTRATOR: Verifies a standardized payment attestation generated by the attestation service.\n     * NOTE: This contract has write permissions on nullifier registry, and nullifies the payment after verification.\n     * Hence only Orchestrator can call this function to prevent griefing.\n     *\n     * @param _verifyPaymentData Payment proof and intent details required for verification\n     * @return result The payment verification result containing success status, intent hash, and release amount\n     * @dev Ensure the orchestrator verifies the intent exists before calling this function\n     */\n    function verifyPayment(\n        VerifyPaymentData calldata _verifyPaymentData\n    )\n        external\n        override\n        onlyOrchestrator()\n        returns (PaymentVerificationResult memory result)\n    {\n        PaymentAttestation memory attestation = _decodeAttestation(_verifyPaymentData.paymentProof);\n        require(attestation.intentHash == _verifyPaymentData.intentHash, \"UPV: Attestation hash mismatch\");\n        require(attestation.releaseAmount != 0, \"UPV: Invalid release amount\");\n\n        (\n            PaymentDetails memory paymentDetails,\n            IntentSnapshot memory intentSnapshot\n        ) = _decodeAttestationPayload(attestation.data);\n        require(isPaymentMethod[paymentDetails.method], \"UPV: Invalid payment method\");\n        require(paymentDetails.method == intentSnapshot.paymentMethod, \"UPV: Payment method mismatch\");\n        require(paymentDetails.paymentId != bytes32(0), \"UPV: Invalid payment ID\");\n        require(paymentDetails.amount != 0, \"UPV: Invalid payment amount\");\n        require(paymentDetails.currency != bytes32(0), \"UPV: Invalid payment currency\");\n\n        bytes memory intentData = _validateIntentSnapshot(_verifyPaymentData.intentHash, intentSnapshot);\n\n        bool isValid = _verifyAttestation(attestation);\n        require(isValid, \"UPV: Invalid attestation\");\n\n        if (intentData.length != 0) {\n            (IPaymentValidationHook hook, bytes memory hookData) =\n                abi.decode(intentData, (IPaymentValidationHook, bytes));\n            hook.validatePayment(attestation.intentHash, attestation.data, hookData);\n        }\n\n        // Nullify the payment to prevent double-spending\n        _nullifyPayment(paymentDetails.method, paymentDetails.paymentId, attestation.intentHash);\n\n        _emitPaymentDetails(attestation.intentHash, paymentDetails);\n\n        uint256 releaseAmount = _calculateReleaseAmount(attestation.releaseAmount, intentSnapshot.amount);\n        result = PaymentVerificationResult({\n            success: true,\n            intentHash: attestation.intentHash,\n            releaseAmount: releaseAmount\n        });\n\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    /* ============ Internal Functions ============ */\n\n    function _decodeAttestation(bytes memory paymentProof) internal pure returns (PaymentAttestation memory) {\n        return abi.decode(paymentProof, (PaymentAttestation));\n    }\n\n    function _decodeAttestationPayload(bytes memory paymentData)\n        internal\n        pure\n        returns (PaymentDetails memory paymentDetails, IntentSnapshot memory intentSnapshot)\n    {\n        (paymentDetails, intentSnapshot) = abi.decode(paymentData, (PaymentDetails, IntentSnapshot));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Verifies the EIP-712 attestation using the attestation verifier. Also verifies the integrity of the\n     * verify payment data using the data hash attached to the attestation.\n     */\n    function _verifyAttestation(PaymentAttestation memory attestation) internal view returns (bool) {\n        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(\n            abi.encode(\n                PAYMENT_ATTESTATION_TYPEHASH,\n                attestation.intentHash,\n                attestation.releaseAmount,\n                attestation.dataHash\n            )\n        );\n\n        bytes32 digest = keccak256(\n            abi.encodePacked(\n                \"\\x19\\x01\",\n                DOMAIN_SEPARATOR,\n                structHash\n            )\n        );\n\n        // Verify data integrity - the data hash must match what was signed\n        require(\n            keccak256(attestation.data) == attestation.dataHash,\n            \"UPV: Data hash mismatch\"\n        );\n\n        bool isValid = attestationVerifier.verify(\n            digest,\n            attestation.signatures,\n            attestation.data\n        );\n\n        return isValid;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Reads intent data from the Orchestrator and checks them against the intent data provided by the\n     * attestation verifier.\n     */\n    function _validateIntentSnapshot(\n        bytes32 intentHash,\n        IntentSnapshot memory snapshot\n    ) internal view returns (bytes memory intentData) {\n        require(snapshot.intentHash == intentHash, \"UPV: Snapshot hash mismatch\");\n\n        if (_isV2Orchestrator(msg.sender)) {\n            IOrchestratorV2.Intent memory intentV2 = IOrchestratorV2(msg.sender).getIntent(intentHash);\n            intentData = intentV2.data;\n            _validateSnapshotAgainstIntent(\n                snapshot,\n                intentV2.payeeId,\n                intentV2.amount,\n                intentV2.paymentMethod,\n                intentV2.fiatCurrency,\n                intentV2.conversionRate,\n                intentV2.timestamp\n            );\n        } else {\n            IOrchestrator.Intent memory intent = IOrchestrator(msg.sender).getIntent(intentHash);\n            intentData = intent.data;\n            _validateSnapshotAgainstIntent(\n                snapshot,\n                intent.payeeId,\n                intent.amount,\n                intent.paymentMethod,\n                intent.fiatCurrency,\n                intent.conversionRate,\n                intent.timestamp\n            );\n        }\n\n        require(snapshot.timestampBuffer <= MAX_TIMESTAMP_BUFFER, \"UPV: Snapshot timestamp buffer exceeds maximum\");\n    }\n\n    function _validateSnapshotAgainstIntent(\n        IntentSnapshot memory snapshot,\n        bytes32 payeeId,\n        uint256 amount,\n        bytes32 paymentMethod,\n        bytes32 fiatCurrency,\n        uint256 conversionRate,\n        uint256 signalTimestamp\n    ) internal pure {\n        require(snapshot.payeeDetails == payeeId, \"UPV: Snapshot payee mismatch\");\n        require(snapshot.amount == amount, \"UPV: Snapshot amount mismatch\");\n        require(snapshot.paymentMethod == paymentMethod, \"UPV: Snapshot method mismatch\");\n        require(snapshot.fiatCurrency == fiatCurrency, \"UPV: Snapshot currency mismatch\");\n        require(snapshot.conversionRate == conversionRate, \"UPV: Snapshot rate mismatch\");\n        require(snapshot.signalTimestamp == signalTimestamp, \"UPV: Snapshot timestamp mismatch\");\n    }\n\n    function _isV2Orchestrator(address orchestrator) internal view returns (bool isV2Orchestrator) {\n        (isV2Orchestrator, ) = orchestrator.staticcall(\n            abi.encodeWithSelector(\n                GET_DEPOSIT_PRE_INTENT_HOOK_SELECTOR,\n                address(0),\n                0\n            )\n        );\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Nullifies a payment to prevent double-spending\n     * @dev Creates a unique nullifier by encoding both the payment method and payment ID together.\n     * This prevents collisions where the same payment ID could exist across different payment\n     * methods (e.g., Venmo transaction #123 vs PayPal transaction #123).\n     */\n    function _nullifyPayment(bytes32 paymentMethod, bytes32 paymentId, bytes32 intentHash) internal {\n        bytes32 nullifier = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(paymentMethod, paymentId));\n        _validateAndAddNullifier(nullifier, intentHash);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Calculates the release amount for an intent by capping the release amount to the intent amount\n     */\n    function _calculateReleaseAmount(uint256 releaseAmount, uint256 intentAmount) internal pure returns (uint256) {\n        if (releaseAmount > intentAmount) {\n            return intentAmount;\n devdoc.details: The policy owns no tokens. StakeVault is the source of truth for collateral locks, a dedicated `disputeNullifierRegistry` deployment is the source of truth for consumed dispute nullifiers, and the calling Orchestrator is the source of truth for valid escrows and intents. TRUST: Dispute protection intents are keyed by intent hash, which embeds the originating orchestrator (OrchestratorV3 hashes its own address into every intent hash), so identities do not collide across orchestrators. Lifecycle entrypoints trust every orchestrator admitted by OrchestratorRegistry to invoke callbacks only for intents it created and already validated against its EscrowRegistry. Registering an orchestrator is therefore a governance assertion about its callback behavior. TOKEN: The stake token, and therefore every protected deposit token, must not call recipients on transfer: such callbacks expose an unfixed stake-mode switch during fulfillment (see `setIntentNoStake`). Governance must authorize a lifecycle hook here before configuring it on an Orchestrator. Predecessor hooks must remain authorized until all intents snapshotted to them have been cancelled or settled. Likewise, an orchestrator must be drained before it is removed from OrchestratorRegistry. Pending protected intents must drain before StakeVault controller authority moves. Settled locks must also drain unless the replacement explicitly adopts them or governance ends their coverage through releasePredecessorLocks.

A zero configured risk window is an unrestricted pass-through for this direct policy callback; the canonical lifecycle hook never calls this function for a zero-window payment method and applies the whitelist instead. It creates no dispute protection intent. Otherwise the call validates deposit configuration and token compatibility, snapshots the risk configuration, and locks the taker's selected stake, unless no-stake admission is requested. No-stake intents require a verified bypass flag or an explicit taker switch to staked mode before ordinary fulfillment.

setAdmissionsPaused(bool).details: It rejects every non-whitelisted taker on every non-opted-out deposit payment method with a nonzero risk window. Whitelisted takers return from the lifecycle hook before this policy is reached, and payment methods with a zero risk window return before the pause check. Explicitly opted-out deposit payment methods and zero-window payment methods never reach this policy and stay gated by the whitelist or open. Cancellation, settlement, release, and dispute submission remain available while admissions are paused.

The requested value is emitted as-is; the effective state also depends on the payment method's current risk window. OrchestratorV3 validates Escrow registration before signaling an intent; this policy only verifies that the caller is the deposit's current depositor.

setIntentNoStake(address,bytes32,bool).details: Staked mode locks the full intent amount using the current stake owner. No-stake mode unlocks it and requires a signed bypass flag at fulfillment. No-stake follows the same access rules as staked mode. The saved risk window is unchanged. Funding and fulfillment are separate calls.WARNING: OrchestratorV3 reads stake mode twice during fulfillment: in `validatePayment`, called by the verifier during `verifyPayment`, and in `onIntentSettled`, called from `settleIntent`. Between these reads it prunes the intent and transfers the deposit token, including referral fees to recipients chosen by the taker at signal. This function remains callable while the policy record is PENDING, so a recipient callback (e.g. an ERC-777-style hook) can let a taker contract switch a staked intent to no-stake mid-fulfillment; settlement then releases it immediately without collateral, a risk window, or a signed bypass flag. `releaseFundsToPayer` has the same gap. It is unreachable while `stakeVault.stakeToken()` has no transfer callbacks (USDC today), since every protected deposit token must equal the stake token; intentionally unfixed. Possible fixes: require `_orchestrator.getIntent(_intentHash).owner == intent.taker` on a validated orchestrator in both switch directions (OrchestratorV3 prunes before any transfer), or have `validatePayment` record that its check ran and require that record in `onIntentSettled`.

params._intentHash: Pending intent whose mode is changing.
params._noStake: Whether fulfillment must bypass the collateral window.
params._orchestrator: Registered orchestrator that owns the intent; only read and validated when switching to staked mode.
